messages:
alex: Nightly CI went red on main — 4 integration tests failing in the smoke suite. Last green build was 1987620000. Can someone run a bisect or pointer to last-green? @maria any idea if recent merges touched infra fixtures?
ci-bot: nightly-run: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/1987654319 — logs attached. Failing tests: infra/db_migrations_test, api/seq_cache_integ, deploy/bootstrap_smoke, storage/kv_snapshot_test.
maria: thx. I saw a couple infra fixture tweaks landed last night: PR 4529 (test-fixtures: db txn retry), PR 4531 (cache: kv-init tweak). Could be either.
jyoti: I'll take a quick bisect. tagging @sre-oncall in case we need extra runners.
sre-oncall: Ack — I can spin an isolated runner in us-west for bisect. Avoid reverting until we confirm culprit, pls.
jyoti: starting git bisect between 1987620000..HEAD locally, running failing test case with `make smoke-test` and `--filter infra/db_migrations_test`. Will report progress.
alex: thanks. If bisect points at a recent merge, let's prefer hotfix/patch revert PR over full rollback of main. Also, keep the oncall looped for prod-facing risk.
jyoti: quick update: reproduced failure locally on commit a1b2c3d (recent merge from PR 4529). Re-running `infra/db_migrations_test` with `-run TestTransactionRetry` gives consistent failure. Stack: ```
--- FAIL: TestTransactionRetry (0.12s)
    migrations_test.go:84: expected retry on transient error, got panic: invalid migration state
    runtime stack: goroutine 23 [running]:
```
maria: that's the PR I flagged. PR 4529 changed the migration ordering and fixture cleanup. Might have introduced a race.
sre-oncall: if it's consistent, let's prepare a revert PR for 4529 and land as hotfix, then requeue nightly. Who will open the revert?
jyoti: I'll open a revert PR (revert: test-fixtures: db txn retry — PR 4529) and run CI on it. Posting link when created.
alex: please also include a changelog note and link to failing jobs in PR description so release folks see it.
ci-bot: rerun-requested: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/1987654401 (rerun with revert candidate).
maria: after revert lands, follow-up: we should add a small regression test exercising ordering + cleanup to avoid regression. I'll draft that.
jyoti: revert PR opened: https://git.redwood.example/pulls/4567 — running full smoke now. If CI is green, we'll merge and unstick nightly.
sre-oncall: thanks all. ping @alex when merged and I'll monitor rollout. :thumbsup:
alex: ack, will watch. Good catch, jyoti.
